mapper.select: SELECT ar.*, an.node_name, u.real_name AS approver_name, u.role AS approver_role FROM approval_record ar LEFT JOIN approval_node an ON ar.node_id = an.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ar.approver_id = u.id WHERE ar.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND ar.subject_id = #{subjectId} ORDER BY ar.create_time ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM approval_record WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId}
